Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for exact activity measurements in assay CHEMBL3705960. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL3705960 and keep only rows where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
